items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: but I think they felt that they would be able to express themselves a little more fully, coming with us, and that's what happened.

ctx.x: Charlie's band and so was Chubby, and so was Francis Lane. Wayne.

And -- but I think they felt that they would be able to express themselves a little more fully, coming with us, and that's what happened. That was a transition period, and that's when we -- then I started to look for people and found people like Bill Harris and -- who'd been in a few bands, but no one had really utilized him. And from there, -- as a matter of fact, he had just done the Benny Goodman -- the a picture with Benny Goodman, prior to joining me. And I think that was probably the first time he was…

And then Flip Phillips came in the band. I got him from Russ Wes Morgan's band in New York. And he stayed with the band about a month, and then he got worried because he figured that Russ Wes Morgan was a much more working band, and that his success -- and he would be able to call his shots and be able to keep everybody happy, working.
